column1: # Black/Matrix AD - Chapter 4 Sodom industry and civic interactions
# No manual wrapping: patchline.py supplies pixel-aware line breaks.

column2: This is the factory with the rotary iron furnace that supports this city's industry.
Thanks to it, we can mass-produce iron many times stronger than anything we had before.
Amazing, is it not? Look at the state-of-the-art textile mill next door!
It is fully automated, using steam that rises from the earth to turn its pulleys!
What do you think? This building is enormous!
No other city has the technology to build anything like it.
We are building an inn here. Everyone is working hard, are they not?
That too is because we do not care about birth or $$羽$$ color,
and let capable people take on important work!!
This city is splendid, is it not? It is proof of how hard we have worked!
We found that when we work together regardless of $$羽$$ color,
the city becomes this much more splendid!
Here, $$羽$$ color does not matter!
Your income is guaranteed according to your work.
There is as much work as you could ever look for,
so frankly, anyone who does not work in this city is trash!!
The $$領主$$, $$スタン$$, was the hardest worker in this city.
That is why he was chosen as $$領主$$!!
Even as a white $$羽$$ person, I can take any job I like and have $$自由$$ to work in this city!
Before coming here, I was treated as a $$奴隷$$...
In my previous city, no matter how much I worked, my $$ご主人様$$ took all my earnings.
But here in Sodom, the more you work, the more your effort is guaranteed as income...
No one can take my earnings without cause simply because I am white $$羽$$!
It is like a dream!!
You lot...
You are wanted runaway $$逃亡奴隷$$s, are you not!?
Yes
No
This city has a permanent polling station, a source of pride for its residents.
I too was chosen fairly by the people of this city in that vote.
If this city's $$領主$$ does anything improper, they are immediately replaced by someone new.
How fair and wonderful that is!
Oh, yes, of course!
This is the $$領主$$'s residence. Well, my current home, that is!
Please, come inside.
